description: Full point-to-point HVDC link: rectifier station loss (~0.7% LCC / ~1.0% VSC) + DC line resistive loss + inverter station loss; LCC reactive demand model; bipolar DC line.

unit.name: Generic ±500 kV LCC-HVDC Link, 1000 MW, 500 km
unit.source: Cigre TB 492 (2012) VSC Transmission; Cigre TB 388 (2009) LCC HVDC; EPRI (2012) HVDC Design Guide; Kundur (1994) Power System Stability and Control. McGraw-Hill; ABB (2019) HVDC Reference Projects.

loss_factor_station.note: 0.7% per LCC station at rated power (Cigre TB 388; ABB 2019). VSC ~1.0%.

P_no_load_MW.note: No-load / auxiliary losses per station (cooling, controls, transformer)

line_R_ohm_per_km.note: DC cable/OHL resistance (bipolar: ~10 mOhm/km total per pole, XLPE cable typical)

Q_demand_factor.note: LCC: reactive demand = Q_demand_factor * P_transfer (approx 0.5 at rated, varies with firing angle)

Q_cap_MVAR.note: Harmonic filter / shunt capacitor bank at each station (provides reactive for LCC)

alpha_line_R.note: Temperature coefficient of DC line resistance (copper or aluminium conductor)

n_stations.note: Number of converter stations in link (2 for P2P)
